Status: Wave 276 accepted (6.3): ft device-loadability and serial-number operations

Method.evidence: Two HawkNET rows in type ft, both read from their own IL. ft::e (0x060004C6) is the device-loadability check: it formats the literal "Not loadable {0}" and the ErrorMessage_DeviceNotLoadable resource (resource-rows.py) before throwing a DeviceManagementException, so it is CheckDeviceLoadable. ft::b (0x060004D5) returns Task<Knx.Falcon.SerialNumber> from the class's asynchronous serial-number extractor, which the byte-identical wrappers 0x060004D3/D4/D6/D7 all call; only the wrapper that carries the async signature is named (ReadSerialNumberAsync) and the four twins stay unresolved as byte-identical siblings.
Method.themes: The resource-name pattern (a row that formats a Resources property is named by that property) plus the literal stream carries another HawkNET type. Negative result confirmed: the DevKit event block akj has all 48 event accessors SDK-protected, so the delegate-typed subscription surface cannot be renamed; only its non-protected event handlers remain, and they need the SubscribeAllEvents wiring (handler-suggest.py does not parse the ldftn/call pairing yet).
